{
 "path": "programs/task-765fb3cb.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    # Full separator rows/columns are the color distinct from the background.
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    sep = next((c for c in colors if c != bg and (any(all(x == c for x in row) for row in grid) or any(all(grid[r][j] == c for r in range(h)) for j in range(w)))), None)
    if sep is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sr = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    sc = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[r][j] == sep for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sr + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sc + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        if r0 >= r1: continue
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            if c0 >= c1: continue
            regions.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    source = None
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
        if any(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != sep for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
            source=(r0,r1,c0,c1); break
    if source is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=source
    sh,sw=r1-r0,c1-c0
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,x,y in regions:
        if b-a != sh or y-x != sw: continue
        for dr in range(sh):
            for dc in range(sw):
                val=grid[r0+dr][c0+dc]
                if val != bg and val != sep:
                    out[a+dr][x+dc]=val
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo=[[5,7,5,5,5,7,5],[7,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,5,7,5],[5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[4]*7]+[[5]*7 for _ in range(4)]+[[4]*7]+[[5]*7 for _ in range(4)]
    expected=demo[:5]+demo[:4]+[demo[9]]+demo[:4]
    assert transform(demo)==expected
    test=[[9]*26 for _ in range(5)]
    for r in range(5): test[r][8]=test[r][17]=4
    test[2]=[4]*26
    for j,v in enumerate([8,9,8,9,6,9,8,7]): test[3][9+j]=v
    for j,v in enumerate([9,9,9,8,8,3,9,9]): test[4][9+j]=v
    print(transform(test))
    print('demo check OK')
    print('test=',transform(test))
    print('top middle=',[row[9:17] for row in transform(test)[:2]])
    print('left top=',[row[:8] for row in transform(test)[:2]])
    print('left bottom=',[row[:8] for row in transform(test)[3:]])
    print('right top=',[row[18:] for row in transform(test)[:2]])
    print('right bottom=',[row[18:] for row in transform(test)[3:]])
    print('bottom middle=',[row[9:17] for row in transform(test)[3:]])
    print('verified demo + generated test')
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
